stories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2, Mythos 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 model family
stories.summary: Anthropic's own blog announces a new set of Claude models across several tiers. Titles give no benchmark or pricing detail.

stories.headline: Anthropic files for, prices and closes its initial public offering, then trades as a public stock
stories.summary: Anthropic filed an S-1, launched a roadshow, priced its IPO and closed it including the greenshoe. Coverage notes the stock has since dropped and has been a bright spot on some days, with analysts split on its outlook.
evidence: covered by NYT, Bloomberg, FT, Reuters, WSJ

stories.headline: Scott Aaronson says leading AI labs hold unreleased algorithmic breakthroughs that could threaten deployed cryptosystems
stories.summary: Aaronson argues the magnitude of current AI progress is under-described and that labs have undisclosed breakthroughs whose nature is unknown. Bank regulators and FT coverage echo encryption worries.
evidence: related FT coverage of encryption concerns

stories.headline: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US tightens export controls
stories.summary: Multiple outlets report Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after a new US rule requiring licences for advanced chip purchases there.
evidence: covered by FT, Reuters, NYT, Forbes

stories.headline: US closes remote-access loophole and restricts Chinese access to Nvidia chips, hitting China's AI development
stories.summary: Washington closed a loophole letting Chinese firms use Nvidia compute in Southeast Asia and reportedly told GPU buyers to rule out Chinese renters. Reports say curbs threaten Chinese model development.
evidence: covered by WSJ, CNBC, Reuters, Businesskorea

stories.headline: Z.AI's GLM-5.5 flagship reportedly delayed as US curbs and distillation crackdown bite
stories.summary: Sources say Z.AI's 3-trillion-parameter GLM-5.5 missed its November target and could slip into 2027; Moonshot says release intervals are lengthening.

stories.headline: Apple pulls MiniMax's Talkie chatbot from the App Store worldwide over sexualised content
stories.summary: Apple removed the chatbot after reporting showed AI characters sexualising children; a MiniMax data-access report also surfaced.

stories.headline: SAP weighs at least 10,000 job cuts to remake its software business for the AI era
stories.summary: Bloomberg and FT report SAP is preparing to eliminate roughly 9% of its global staff.

stories.headline: Bank of England's Bailey says unreleased AI models raise encryption concerns; BoE cuts bank capital requirements
stories.summary: Bailey warns mathematical breakthroughs in AI threaten financial encryption, while the BoE moves to lower capital requirements and flags AI cyber risk.

stories.headline: S&P considers downgrading Nvidia credit over governance and key-man risk
stories.summary: S&P may cut Nvidia's rating to AA-, citing governance lapses tied to Jensen Huang's brief removal and reinstatement.
evidence: covered by TechCrunch, The Information, Moody's commentary

stories.headline: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares to every US child, worth about $18.4B
stories.summary: Musk doubled an earlier pledge, routing the shares through Trump Accounts.
evidence: covered by Bloomberg, Reuters, Guardian, Axios

stories.headline: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work with a single usage meter; GPT-6.2 billing error corrected
stories.summary: OpenAI says heavy users will hit limits sooner after combining its two experiences, and it admitted a billing mistake that had discounted GPT-6.2 Astra usage.

stories.headline: GPT-6.2 Astra beats Googlers' code golf records
stories.summary: A community post reports OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra as the first model to beat human code golf records.

stories.headline: Meta launches Muse Spark 1.1, Muse Image and Muse Video models
stories.summary: Meta announced new Muse-family models including an image and a video generator; the FCA has criticised Meta for declining joint testing of its Muse agent.

stories.headline: Microsoft says China and North Korea state hackers use AI pentesting tool ARTEX
stories.summary: Microsoft's report says state-backed groups including Salt Typhoon have added the AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their operations.

stories.headline: Switzerland reports AI agents used in five cyberattacks
stories.summary: The Swiss government says AI agents were involved in five attacks, and retailers face rising AI-driven cyber threats before Black Friday.

stories.headline: Anthropic publishes a wave of policy, science, partnership and governance announcements
stories.summary: Anthropic's blog posts cover public-benefit investment, AI for Science, drug development, the Cyber Mission, government and Singapore deals, Barclays rollout, and a usage-policy update.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude marketplace experiment and Claude Code origin story published
stories.summary: Anthropic published Project Deal, an experiment in a Claude-run marketplace, and a behind-the-scenes look at Claude Code.

stories.headline: Thomson Reuters to launch AI model built on Chinese and US open-source
stories.summary: Dataconomy reports Thomson Reuters plans a model combining Chinese and US open-source components.

stories.headline: llama.cpp adds AMD-specific patches and a Ryzen/Radeon benchmark dashboard
stories.summary: Community and Hugging Face posts bring AMD optimisations and benchmarks to the llama.cpp inference stack.

stories.headline: Google will make AI agents use its MCP servers, Gmail MCP server cannot send email
stories.summary: A report notes Google is steering AI agents to its MCP servers, with the Gmail one lacking send capability.

stories.headline: Commandcode launches Moat, an OpenRouter replacement
stories.summary: Commandcode presents Moat as an alternative to the OpenRouter model routing service.

stories.headline: Thariq Shihipar leaves Anthropic to join OpenAI
stories.summary: A former Anthropic engineer announced he has joined OpenAI.

stories.headline: Memory chip shortage sends prices up tenfold and prompts procurement war rooms
stories.summary: Reports say memory chip prices have risen sharply, pushing up electronics costs worldwide.

stories.headline: AI startups raise funding: Avicena, Lute, ElevenLabs talks, Mawj
stories.summary: Avicena raised a $100M+ Series C with SK Hynix, Samsung and AMD participating; ElevenLabs is in early talks at a $33B valuation; Lute and Mawj raised smaller rounds.

stories.headline: Situational Awareness fund says it was down 65% in Q3 but up 88.5% for the year
stories.summary: Aschenbrenner's hedge fund shared an investor letter describing its volatile summer and year-to-date returns.

stories.headline: UK FCA plans stricter authorisation rules for DeFi platforms after Binance hack
stories.summary: The FCA will require DeFi platforms to be authorised, taking a tougher line than the US and EU.

stories.headline: Neuralink receives FDA approval for pivotal trial of brain implant in ALS patients
stories.summary: The FDA approved Neuralink's LINK pivotal study to test its brain-computer interface in ALS patients.

stories.headline: Pentagon discussed Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The Washington Post reports Pentagon officials floated using wartime law to reappoint Huang; officials dispute national-security concerns around him.

stories.headline: Trump to lead TSMC Arizona expansion groundbreaking on December 4
stories.summary: The President will attend a ceremony for the expansion of TSMC's Arizona chip factories.

stories.headline: Netherlands will resist proposed US curbs on ASML chip sales to China
stories.summary: The Dutch government says it will oppose further US restrictions on ASML and may not enforce the MATCH Act.

stories.headline: Fitch says US chip curbs will slow Asian data-centre investment
stories.summary: Fitch expects the chip restrictions to dampen data-centre spending across Asia.

stories.headline: Power-cost backlash threatens NextEra-Dominion deal; Texas resumes data-centre permitting
stories.summary: Public anger over electricity bills complicates a $67bn utility tie-up, while Texas restarts data-centre permits before a change of governor.

stories.headline: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites for orbital AI data centres
stories.summary: Federal regulators approved the Starmind constellation for space-based data centres.

stories.headline: 42 state attorneys general move to block Character.AI from selling user chats in bankruptcy
stories.summary: A coalition of AGs is trying to stop the sale of user data during Character.AI's Chapter 11 case.

stories.headline: Dutch groups seek court halt to Meta smart glasses sales over privacy
stories.summary: Privacy groups in the Netherlands ask a court to suspend sales of Meta's smart glasses.

stories.headline: New York and California move on AI safety laws: Hochul vetoes bill, NY AG creates enforcement unit, California seeks action
stories.summary: New York's governor vetoed an AI safety bill while setting a chatbot-toy ban; the state attorney general created a unit to enforce the RAISE Act; California's governor has 30 days on AI safety bills.

stories.headline: Congress faces obstacles to bipartisan AI regulation as Democrats demand new restrictions
stories.summary: NYT and Axios report bipartisan interest in AI rules but stalled legislative progress.

stories.headline: Undisclosed AI use affects dozens of court cases in England and Wales
stories.summary: A Guardian investigation found at least 25 cases with AI-generated witness statements, fictitious case law and nonexistent statutes.

stories.headline: OpenAI taps Cravath litigator for court battle with Musk
stories.summary: Reuters reports OpenAI has hired a Cravath litigator for its showdown with Musk.

stories.headline: Andreessen Horowitz eyes about $20B for next funds
stories.summary: Axios reports a targeted raise of around $20B for a16z's next set of funds.

stories.headline: Institutional investors sell older VC fund stakes at discounts to back AI funds
stories.summary: FT reports pension funds and endowments are selling legacy VC stakes cheaply to fund AI investments.

stories.headline: Batch of arXiv research papers on RL, agents, robotics, video and multimodal models
stories.summary: Hugging Face Papers lists many preprints on reinforcement learning, coding agents, robotics and multimodal generation. None is a flagship result.

stories.headline: Hugging Face publishes multi-agent training guide and Nemotron 3.5 Parse fine-tuning post
stories.summary: Hugging Face blog posts cover building multi-agent systems and a Nemotron parsing update.

stories.headline: Regional AI product and research news: BharatGen Patram 1.5, Harrison.ai radiology model, Nihin Media funding, Fault Line safety funding
stories.summary: Smaller launches and funding items from India, Japan, the UK and the US, plus academic studies on AI's research and use.
